newsitem.title: GREECE: Hellenic Bottling, Coca Cola to renew accords.
newsitem.headline: Hellenic Bottling, Coca Cola to renew accords.

text.p: Greece's Hellenic Bottling and Coca Cola Company will renew accords for the bottling and distrubution of world leading soft drinks due to expire in mid-1997 for 10 more years, Hellenic Bottling said in a statement.
Hellenic Bottling also announced its intention to participate in the expansion programme of Molino Beverages Holding and maintain its 30 percent stake in it, it said.
Molino Beverages bottles and distributes the products of the Coca Cola Company in the republic of Ireland, Northern Ireland, Russia, Romania and Moldova, it said.
Molino will expand operations in Russia, East of the Urals, and acquire a majority interest of 51 percent in Nigerian Bottling Company (NBC), it said.

"NBC is a public company listed on the Lagos stock exchange..it is the largest industrial enterprise in the country, excluding those in the oil sector, and its 1996 pre-tax profits are expected to exceed $20 million," it said.
"NBC and Molino are part of the Leventis organisation, one of the worldwide leading bottlers of the Coca Cola system," it said.

Coca Cola Company and the Leventis group have agreed to further strengthen their relationship which dates back to 1951 with Coca Cola Company acquiring a minority interest in the Russian operations of Molino, it added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
